def_en: 1) head, top, summit, upper part, chief, total, sum, height, front, beginning
1d) chief, head (of man, city, nation, place, family, priest)
kjv: band, beginning, captain, chapiter, chief(-est place, man, things), company, end, [idiom] every (man), excellent, first, forefront, (be-)head, height, (on) high(-est part, (priest)), [idiom] lead, [idiom] poor, principal, ruler, sum, top.
expl: the head (as most easily shaken), whether literal or figurative (in many applications, of place, time, rank, itc.)
etim: from an unused root apparently meaning to shake;
